design: INDIVIDUAL 13: an aged but huge heavily built council elder, dark green-black hide, broad compact head with deep thick orbital ridges, thick black tendrils interwoven with a few ivory cylinders and tied low. Heavy brown-purple ankle-length split coat with bronze scale-like collar ornament and two wide off-white rank ribbons. Both hands support a shallow rectangular tray holding three distinct carved council stones. Solid wide squat stance, complete clawed feet.
